description:
A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back.
If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired.
The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order.
The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software.
After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested.
If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ComputerRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/computer-repair">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer handed in"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCost" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairApproval" name="Repair approved"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairRejection" name="Repair rejected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairedComputer" name="Repaired computer returned"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair" name="Computer repair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BringIn" name="Defective computer" sourceRef="SendTask_BringIn" targetRef="StartEvent_ComputerReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCost" targetRef="Catch_RepairCost"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Repair approved" sourceRef="SendTask_Approve" targetRef="Catch_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Repair rejected" sourceRef="SendTask_Reject" targetRef="Catch_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Repaired computer" sourceRef="SendTask_ReturnComputer" targetRef="Catch_RepairedComputer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BringComputer" name="Customer has defective computer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_BringIn" name="Bring in defective computer" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairCost" name="Repair cost calculation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairCost" messageRef="Message_RepairCost"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_CostDecision" name="Costs acceptable?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Approve" name="Approve repair" messageRef="Message_RepairApproval"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairedComputer" name="Repaired computer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairedComputer" messageRef="Message_RepairedComputer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Computer repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Reject" name="Reject repair" messageRef="Message_RepairRejection"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_TakeHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_BringComputer" targetRef="SendTask_BringIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="SendTask_BringIn" targetRef="Catch_RepairCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Catch_RepairCost" targetRef="Gw_CostDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_CostDecision" targetRef="SendTask_Approve"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_CostDecision" targetRef="SendTask_Reject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="SendTask_Approve" targetRef="Catch_RepairedComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Catch_RepairedComputer" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="SendTask_Reject" targetRef="Task_TakeHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Task_TakeHome" targetRef="End_TakenHome"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ComputerReceived" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ComputerReceived" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendCost" name="Send repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCost"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gw_CustomerDecision" name="Customer decision"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Approval" name="Repair approved">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Approval" messageRef="Message_RepairApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Rejection" name="Repair rejected">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Rejection" messageRef="Message_RepairRejection"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairCancelled" name="Repair cancelled, computer unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_RepairSplit" name="Start repair activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRepairHW1" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHW1" name="Test hardware functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckConfigSW1" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSW1" name="Test software functionality"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_RepairJoin" name="Repair activities completed"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_LoopMerge" name="Repair step merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ErrorCheck" name="Error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_NextRepairSplit" name="Select next repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRepairHW2" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHW2" name="Test hardware functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckConfigSW2" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSW2" name="Test software functionality"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReturnComputer" name="Return repaired computer" messageRef="Message_RepairedComputer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ComputerReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="SendTask_SendCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCost" targetRef="Gw_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R4" sourceRef="Gw_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Catch_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R5" sourceRef="Gw_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Catch_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R6" sourceRef="Catch_Rejection" targetRef="End_RepairCancelled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R7" sourceRef="Catch_Approval" targetRef="Gw_RepairSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R8" sourceRef="Gw_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRepairHW1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R9" sourceRef="Task_CheckRepairHW1" targetRef="Task_TestHW1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R10" sourceRef="Task_TestHW1" targetRef="Gw_RepairJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R11" sourceRef="Gw_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckConfigSW1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R12" sourceRef="Task_CheckConfigSW1" targetRef="Task_TestSW1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R13" sourceRef="Task_TestSW1" targetRef="Gw_RepairJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R14" sourceRef="Gw_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gw_LoopMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R15" sourceRef="Gw_LoopMerge" targetRef="Gw_ErrorCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R16" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_ErrorCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReturnComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R17" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_ErrorCheck" targetRef="Gw_NextRepairSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R18" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gw_NextRepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRepairHW2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R19" sourceRef="Task_CheckRepairHW2" targetRef="Task_TestHW2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R20" sourceRef="Task_TestHW2" targetRef="Gw_LoopMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R21" name="Software" sourceRef="Gw_NextRepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckConfigSW2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R22" sourceRef="Task_CheckConfigSW2" targetRef="Task_TestSW2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R23" sourceRef="Task_TestSW2" targetRef="Gw_LoopMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R24" sourceRef="SendTask_ReturnComputer" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
